oneOf.description:
The generation activated without an envelope (provisioned before the
envelope amendment, or without the codegen-owned members).

AppCliTargetFactsV1.description:
The `app-cli.target` eligibility descriptor (LLP 0062 §4; dated LLP 0058
amendment 2026-08-01).

Deliberately a **structured descriptor**, not a ninth entry in the closed
`TargetCapabilityId` string set: §4 requires a target to state *which*
principal classes it supports, whether it serves envelopes and accepts
generation assertions, and the per-grant token cap the engine's admission
bound must read rather than hardcode. A boolean could carry none of that.

Absence is the honest capability-absent report — §4's rule that the engine
"never infers any of this from a URL" has teeth only because this fact
exists to read. Facts state what the target *supports*; they never prove
transport locality, which is why the agent lane's loopback condition stays
engine-enforced.

acceptsGenerationAssertions.description:
Whether the target admits caller-asserted `expectedGeneration`
(LLP 0012's call-time binding).

capabilityId.description: The working capability id this descriptor answers for.

perGrantTokenCap.description:
The per-grant live-token cap the engine's cross-process admission
bound reads. `None` where the target admits no agent lane — a
hardcoded copy of LLP 0055's constant would drift silently.

principalClasses.description:
Closed principal-class vocabulary this target admits, from §4's
matrix: `anonymous`, `dev`, `session`, `agent`. A class the target
refuses is simply absent — the engine reports the refusal as a target
capability rather than a bug.

servesEnvelopes.description: Whether the target composes and serves `/app-api/*` envelopes.

appCliDescriptor.description:
The `app-cli.target` descriptor itself, echoed here because LLP 0062
§4 requires eligibility to ride the capability manifest "and echoed by
sessions discovery": the engine reads this credential-free, before any
principal is selected, so a refused lane is a stated target capability
rather than an inference from the URL. Absent = capability-absent.

appCliTarget.description:
Whether this target advertises the `app-cli.target` eligibility
capability (LLP 0062 §4). Advisory pre-flag; the engine still treats
absence as capability-absent.

engineRange.description: Advisory engine-version range. None until a range is published.

envelope.description:
The current envelope, or the typed absent marker (never a 404: an
envelope-less generation is an admissible state whose tuple still
binds).
